svg.aria-label: Dead zone of total width D = 1 (no output for |x| below D/2 = 0.5) and slope K = 1, driven by X = 1.5: the output is a sine with its middle cut out; the describing function is real and rises towards K for large X
svg.title: Dead zone of total width D = 1 (no output for |x| below D/2 = 0.5) and slope K = 1, driven by X = 1.5: the output is a sine with its middle cut out; the describing function is real and rises towards K for large X

g.text: output y (blue) and its fundamental (pink dashed)
K_N = K[1 − (2/π)(α + sin α cos α)]
sin α = D/(2X); K_N = 0 for X ≤ D/2
